description: CANCEL a booking before fulfillment: full refund out of escrow (escrow flips to REFUNDED). Works while escrow is HELD and inside the listing refund window (free/WAIVED bookings cancel too; instant-rail DIRECT bookings have no refund window). Auth for THIS call: THIS booking's cancel_token as the X-Hub-Token header. The chain claim deadline is authoritative - past it only the contract auto-release applies.
